rules.statement: A mortgage decree is a document affecting land and must be registered. An unregistered decree does not bind a grantee who has not given valuable consideration for his grant.
rules.supporting_quote: "That a mortgage decree must be registered was held in the cases of Salman v. Gabo [ 1 1 Leembruggen's Rep. 27.], Madan Lebbe v. Nagamma, [ 2 (1902) 6 N. L. R. 21.] and Adappa Chetty v. Babi (supra)."
